description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class for caching mechanisms within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages cache naming, retrieval, and clearing, related to entity caching in the context of a delegator identified by a name.

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: An abstract class providing cache management functionalities for entities, parameterized with key and value types.

methods.name: AbstractCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a delegator name and id, setting up cache name prefix.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator instance associated with the delegator name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries related to a specific entity.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all caches that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used to generate cache names.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefixes
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name prefix patterns used in the cache management.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Generates the cache name for a specific entity.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name patterns for a given entity, combining base prefixes and specific entity name.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache instance for a specific entity.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache instance for a specific entity.
